YOU.t: This 1-handed ASL sign is produced often with eye gaze directed to the indicated person, thing, group, or empty space: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing up. The index finger points toward the indicated particular person, thing, group, or empty space previously established to represent the indicated entity. Hold briefly. If the referent is a person, the index finger points toward the center of the person's chest (or the center of the figurative chest of an absent person whom the indicated space has been designated to represent). Thus, if the signer's chest is lower or higher than that of the indicated person, the finger points down or up accordingly.

H.t: This 1-handed ASL sign is produced often with eye gaze directed to the indicated person, thing, group, or empty space: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing up. The index finger points toward the indicated particular person, thing, group, or empty space previously established to represent the indicated entity. Hold briefly. If the referent is a person, the index finger points toward the center of the person's chest (or the center of the figurative chest of an absent person whom the indicated space has been designated to represent). Thus, if the signer's chest is lower or higher than that of the indicated person, the finger points down or up accordingly.

CONFUSED.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "1" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing down. Then move to: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the body, palm up, base of the hand parallel with the midline plane. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands in at least one full horizontal circle in the same direction, keeping them on opposite sides of the circle.

CONFUSE.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "1" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing down. Then move to: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the body, palm up, base of the hand parallel with the midline plane. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands in at least one full horizontal circle in the same direction, keeping them on opposite sides of the circle.

START.t: ( as a verb ) This two-handed ASL sign is produced as follows: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "1" shape with the extended main finger or fingers in between those of the other hand, main palm facing down. Move the main hand by rotating it to the next posture while holding the other hand still. Main hand: "1" shape with the extended main finger or fingers in between those of the other hand, main palm facing up. Optionally repeat the move by twisting the main hand back and forth. ( as a noun ) Produced as above, but with the final posture held briefly.

SKIP.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the middle of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand. Strike the index finger of the main hand against the bent middle finger of the other hand while holding the other hand still. Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the middle of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand.

ABSENT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the middle of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand. Strike the index finger of the main hand against the bent middle finger of the other hand while holding the other hand still. Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the middle of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand.

VEHICLE-COLLIDE.t: Two-handed, as follows when used as a verb: Put the other hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, fingers of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Put the main hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, fingers of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Then move to: Other hand: "S" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Main hand: "S" shape knuckles contacting knuckles of other hand, tip of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). When used as a noun, both its postures are held briefly (a common ASL hold pattern for nouns).

VEHICLE-COLLISION.t: Two-handed, as follows when used as a verb: Put the other hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, fingers of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Put the main hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, fingers of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Then move to: Other hand: "S" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Main hand: "S" shape knuckles contacting knuckles of other hand, tip of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). When used as a noun, both its postures are held briefly (a common ASL hold pattern for nouns).

CHINESE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the other shoulder, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Move the hand horizonally across the chest to:. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the main shoulder, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "1" shape on the abdomen, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you.

SANDAL.t: Other hand: "5" shape in front of the other side of the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape over the other hand with the main index finger in the space between the other index and middle fingers, main palm facing down. Move the main hand back and forth, ending with the following posture. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the other side of the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the back of the other hand, main palm facing down. Hold briefly.

SCHEDULE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "4" shape with the main hand at the radial edge of the other palm (near the thumb and index finger), main palm facing down with finger(s) pointing forward and across the body toward the other side. Brush the finger tips of the main hand in a "plaid" pattern over the other hand, first across the palm from thumb side to ulnar (little finger) side. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "4" shape with the main hand at the ulnar edge of the other palm (between the wrist and little finger), main palm facing down with finger(s) pointing forward and across the body toward the other side. Then rotate the main hand so the palm is facing across and toward the body and place the main fingers at the base of the other hand. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "4" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing up with finger(s) pointing toward you and across the body toward the other side. Brush the main fingers to the tip of the other hand. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "4" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing up with finger(s) pointing toward you and across the body toward the other side.

SIGN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the other side of the chest, fingers of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the chest, fingers of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Move both hands in repeating, alternating circles, moving each up, back, down, then forward.

DEAF.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape with the index finger touching the jaw. Hold briefly. Move the hand so the index finger touches the main side of the chin. Hold briefly.

AGREE.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "1" shape with the tip of the index finger touching the side of the forehead, palm facing down. Hold briefly. Other hand: "1" shape in the center of the space in front of the chest, palm facing down, finger pointing forward. At the same time, move the main hand so the radial edge of the index finger contacts that of the other hand, palm facing down, finger pointing forward. Hold briefly.

DISAGREE.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "1" shape with the tip of the index finger touching the side of the forehead, palm facing down. Hold briefly. Other hand: "1" shape in the center of the space in front of the chest, finger pointing across toward the main side. At the same time, move the main hand so the tip of the index finger contacts that of the other hand, finger pointing across toward the other side. Hold briefly. Move both hands apart so they are several inches away from each other. Hold briefly.

THINK.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing down. Move the hand so the index finger contacts the temple in the following posture. Main hand: "1" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing down. Hold briefly.

DON'T-MIND.t: This one-handed ASL sign is usually made while twisting the head from side to side (the typical "no" headshake): Put the hand in the "1" handshape with the finger tip touching the nose. Hold briefly. Twist the hand forward so the finger points forward and slightly down. Hold briefly.

INDIFFERENT.t: This one-handed ASL sign is usually made while twisting the head from side to side (the typical "no" headshake): Put the hand in the "1" handshape with the finger tip touching the nose. Hold briefly. Twist the hand forward so the finger points forward and slightly down. Hold briefly.

ME.t: One-handed: Main hand: bent "1" shape on the middle of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Hold briefly.

I.t: One-handed: Main hand: bent "1" shape on the middle of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Hold briefly.

BLEEDING.t: One-handed: Main hand: "4" shape with the palm facing you, fingers pointing across the face, tip of the index finger touching the nose. Wiggle the fingers of the main hand while moving it toward the ground.

GO.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the other side of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape near the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Then move to: Other hand: "1" shape a comfortable arm's length in front of the other side of the chest (with the elbow just slightly bent), finger(s) of the other hand pointing forward. Main hand: "1" shape near the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing forward.

US.t: One-handed: Main hand: bent "1" shape on the main side of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Move the hand in a horizontal arc forward then to the other side. Main hand: bent "1" shape on the other side of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Hold briefly. To indicate that the non-first-person members of the group are literally or figuratively located somewhere, the signer may lean his or her body and shift the contact point toward that location.

THE-THREE-OF-US.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "3" shape within a few inches of the chest, in between the signer's chest and the other referents, main palm facing up. Move the hand in repeated horizontal circles. The size of the circles indicates the distance the other two referents are from the signer. Hold briefly.

THE-THREE-OF.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "3" shape at least half an arm's length in front of the chest, on the same side of the signer as the referents, main palm facing up. Move the hand in repeated horizontal circles. The size of the circles indicates the distance the referents are from each other. Hold briefly.

LISTEN.t: One-handed, with the head tilted toward to the source of the noise: Main hand: "Bent 3" shape at the main ear (behind the cheek, above the jaw), palm facing out. Hook the fingers repeatedly to indicate the intensity.

AWKWARD.t: Two-handed, with a facial expression suggesting awkwardness: Put the other hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing down. Put the main hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing down. Move both hands alternatingly and repeatedly up and down. Put the other hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing down. Put the main hand in the "3" shape in front of and beside the chest, main palm facing down. ( clumsy ): A different facial expression expresses the meaning "clumsy", typically with the mouthing "TH".

RAINBOW.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "4" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing you and fingers pointing up. Main hand: "4" shape near the other hand's fingertips, main palm facing you and fingers pointing down. Move the main hand in an arc upward, then across toward the main side, then down, to:. Other hand: "4" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing you and fingers pointing up. Main hand: "4" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up. Hold briefly.

HOTDOG.t: Two-handed: Put the other hand in the "C" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm. Move the main hand down so the index finger contacts the palm once or twice. Hold briefly.

FALL-ASLEEP.t: Two-handed, with the head dropping and eyes closing along with the main hand: Main hand: "1" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing down. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the other side of the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "5" shape aside and in front of the nose, main palm facing down. Other hand: "A" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "A" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Hold briefly.

FALL-IN-LOVE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape at the mouth, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand in an arc upward, then forward, then down onto the base of the other palm. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape at the base of the other palm, ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the main hand down. Bounce the main hand up, then forward, then back down to the tip of the other palm. Optionally bounce multiple times along the path from palm base to tip. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape at the tip of the other palm, ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the main hand down.

CORRECT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, fingers of the other hand pointing forward and across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Main hand: "1" shape at the thumb side of the other hand, fingers of the main hand pointing forward and across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Hold briefly.

DIFFERENT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, other index finger pointing across, forward, and optionally up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the back of the finger(s) of the other hand, main index finger across the other index finger. Move both hands apart to:. Other hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest.

SAME.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, other index finger pointing across, forward, and optionally up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the back of the finger(s) of the other hand, main index finger across the other index finger. Move both hands apart to:. Other hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest.

ALIKE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, other index finger pointing across, forward, and optionally up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the back of the finger(s) of the other hand, main index finger across the other index finger. Move both hands apart to:. Other hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "1" shape in front of and beside the chest.

RED.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Retract the index finger while moving the hand down to:. Main hand: "X" shape within a few inches from the chin, main palm facing you.

DUE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down. Drop the main hand down so the finger tip contacts the other hand at least once. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down.

WHERE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Move the finger in a repeated, small side-to-side motion, pivoting at the wrist. When used as a question, this sign is produced with furrowed eyebrows, squinted eyes, head tilted, and a very small headshake (i.e. pivoting slightly from side to side, not nearly so much as that of a "no" gesture).

NERVOUS.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the other side of the body, finger(s) of the other hand pointing down. Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the body, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down. Shake the main finger in a small side-to-side motion.

PHOTOGRAPH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape near the other cheek, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape near the main cheek, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Squeeze both index fingers into hooks. Other hand: "X" shape near the other cheek. Main hand: "X" shape near the main cheek.

WHEN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape near the other hand's fingertips, main palm facing down. Move the main hand in one or more horizontal circles around the other hand before bringing it down so the tips of the two index fingers touch. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape touching the tip(s) of the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing down. When used as a question, this sign is produced with furrowed eyebrows, squinted eyes, head tilted, and a very small headshake (i.e. pivoting slightly from side to side, not nearly so much as that of a "no" gesture).

TOMATO.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "1" shape on the lower lip, main palm facing you. Move the main hand down so the index finger brushes the thumb side of the other hand. Other hand: "O" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape within a few inches of the thumb side of the other hand.

MEET.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand several inches from the thumb of the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand to the other hand so the backs of the thumbs contact each other. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the thumb of the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. This is a directional sign, so the location and orientation of the hands change for inflection. See Inflection, below, for details.

FOUR-YEARS-OLD.t: One-handed: Main hand: "4" shape at the chin, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Move the hand in an arc, first down, the forward. Main hand: "4" shape several inches from the chin, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up.

WEEK.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing down. Slide the main hand across the other hand, toward the tips of the other fingers. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing down.

1-WEEK.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing down. Slide the main hand across the other hand, toward the tips of the other fingers. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing down.

MONTH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape touching the tip(s) of the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing you. Slide the main index finger down the radial edge of the other hand, toward the base of the thumb. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape touching the base of the thumb of the other hand, main palm facing down.

1-MONTH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape touching the tip(s) of the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing you. Slide the main index finger down the radial edge of the other hand, toward the base of the thumb. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "1" shape touching the base of the thumb of the other hand, main palm facing down.

TELL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Move the hand forward and extend the wrist so the index finger tilts forward. Main hand: "1" shape several inches from the chin, main palm facing up.

DEVIL.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "3" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, palm facing out. Repeatedly flex and release the index finger and middle finger, alternating between the "3" and "bent 3" shapes.

CAN'T.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the chest, with the finger pointing to the main side. Main hand: "1" shape above and behind the other hand, palm facing out. Quickly lower the main hand, striking the fingers against each other, ending with the main hand a short distance below the other hand.

CAN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the chest, with the finger pointing to the main side. Main hand: "1" shape above and behind the other hand, palm facing out. Quickly lower the main hand, striking the fingers against each other, ending with the main hand a short distance below the other hand.

ALONE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the neck, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up and palm facing you. Move the hand in horizontal circles.

SOMEONE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the main side of the neck, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up and palm facing you. Move the hand in horizontal circles.

ESCAPE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "5" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Move the main hand forward to:. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape FromFinger, palm facing out.

ESTRANGED.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "5" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Move the main hand forward to:. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing down. Main hand: "1" shape FromFinger, palm facing out.

THREE.t: Put the main hand in the "3" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up.

SAW.t: This two-handed ASL sign has two postures: Main hand: "A" shape near the body, lateral with the main shoulder, at shoulder height, palm facing you, thumb on top. Put non-main hand in the "flat B" handshape about an elbow's length out from the center body, chest high, palm facing down, fingers pointing toward the main side. Move the main hand repeatedly frontward toward the other side and backward toward the main side to the next posture while holding the non-main hand in this posture. Main hand: "A" shape on the back of the other hand, palm facing you, thumb on top.

FINE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "5" shape on the middle of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Touch the thumb one or more times to the middle of the chest. The number of iterations, speed, angle of the hand, and distance moved from the middle of the chest are variable and may be used for emphasis or to add certain frames, styles, or semantic overtones.

COUNT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Put the main hand in the "flat 9" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing down. Move the main hand forward while holding the other hand in this posture. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Put the main hand in the "flat 9" shape with the extended main finger or fingers in between those of the other hand, main palm facing down. Alternatively, both palms may face each other with the fingers of each hand pointing up. In this form, the main hand moves up instead of forward. Alternatively, the main hand may contact the other hand multiple times while it moves from base to tip.

RUDE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Move the main hand across the other palm toward the main side of the body to: while holding the other hand still. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down.

SHARP.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the back of the other hand, main palm facing down. Briefly hold the main hand in this posture. Hold the other hand in this posture for the duration of the sign. Flick the main hand forward and slightly upward. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand near the back of the other hand, main palm facing down.

INTERNET.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the other hand facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with tip of the middle finger touching the tip of the other middle finger, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up.. Twist both hands repeatedly in opposite directions, pivoting on the tips of the middle fingers.

MAN.t: Main hand: "A" shape with the thumb contacting the forehead. Move the main hand down while changing handshape to:. Main hand: "5" shape on the chest, thumb of the main hand pointing toward you.

EARTH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "S" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the thumb and middle finger grasping the other hand, main palm facing down. Twist the main hand repeatedly along the axis running through the tips of the thumb and the index finger. Hold briefly.

GLOBE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "S" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the thumb and middle finger grasping the other hand, main palm facing down. Twist the main hand repeatedly along the axis running through the tips of the thumb and the index finger. Hold briefly.

BREASTS.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "claw 5" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing you. Hold briefly.

SAD.t: Two-handed, with a sad expression on the face: Other hand: "5" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the face, other palm facing you. Main hand: "5" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the face, main palm facing you. Move both hands down to:. Other hand: "5" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the neck, other palm facing you. Main hand: "5" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the neck, main palm facing you. Hold briefly. The degree or type of sadness can be indicated with various nuanced facial expressions and by slowing the downward movement or holding the final posture longer.

SALAD.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing up. Move both hands up and inward to:. Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up.

FRANCE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "9" shape in front of the main side of the neck, main palm facing down. Move the hand aside while twisting the hand to the next posture. Main hand: "9" shape in front of and beside the neck, main palm facing up.

WIKTIONARY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "6" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, main palm facing down. Move the main hand in repeating circles, each brushing the other palm back toward the body, then up, then forward, then down.

SCARED.t: This two-handed ASL sign has two postures: Both hands: "5" shape just in front of the shoulders with palms facing you. Then move to: Both hands: "5" shape just in front of the chest with palms facing you. Hold briefly.

FEAR.t: This two-handed ASL sign has two postures: Both hands: "5" shape just in front of the shoulders with palms facing you. Then move to: Both hands: "5" shape just in front of the chest with palms facing you. Hold briefly.

SNOW.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside from the forehead, other palm facing down. Main hand: "5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside from the forehead, main palm facing down. Move both hands down slowly while wiggling the fingers. Other hand: "5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing down. Be sure to move the hands down slowly to differentiate this sign from Claw5@SideForeheadhigh-PalmDown-Claw5@SideForeheadhigh-PalmDown Claw5@SideChinhigh-PalmDown-Claw5@SideChinhigh-PalmDown Claw5@SideChesthigh-PalmDown-Claw5@SideChesthigh-PalmDown ( " rain " ) API.

SHAMPOO.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape at the other side of the forehead, near the temple. Main hand: "claw 5" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Hold briefly. Move both hands in a circular motion as if you are washing your hair using the shampoo.

FAVORITE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Hold hand still briefly. Tap the middle finger of the main hand on the chin two or more times. Hold briefly.

PREFER.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Hold hand still briefly. Tap the middle finger of the main hand on the chin two or more times. Hold briefly.

MOTHER.t: One-handed: Main hand: "5" shape at the chin, thumb of the main hand pointing toward you. Touch the thumb to the chin one or more times.

I-CONTACT-YOU.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the other hand facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up. Hold briefly. Tap both middle fingers together two or more times. Hold briefly.

CONTACT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the other hand facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up. Hold briefly. Tap both middle fingers together two or more times. Hold briefly.

TOUCH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the other hand facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up. Hold briefly. Tap both middle fingers together two or more times. Hold briefly.

NETWORK.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of the center of the chest, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the other hand facing up. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up. Hold briefly. Tap both middle fingers together two or more times. Hold briefly.

SECRET.t: One-handed: Main hand: "A" shape at the mouth with lips closed, thumb back, palm facing across. Touch the hand to the mouth once or more. Hold briefly.

FAMILY.t: Two-handed: Both hands: "9" shape in front of the chest, palms facing out, the thumb and index finger of each hand touching the thumb and index finger of the other hand. Hold briefly. Move each hand in a horizontal circle while twisting the wrist. Both hands: "9" shape in front of the chest, palms facing you, the little finger of each hand touching the little finger of the other hand. Hold briefly.

TAKE-IT-EASY.t: Two-handed, with the lips pushed out and with the head tilted a little to one side: Both hands: "5" shape, the main hand in front of the chest, the other hand to the other side, both palms facing down. Drop both hands down to the height of the body. Move both hands up and toward the main side. Drop both hands down to the height of the body.

ACT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing down. Swing both hands repeatedly from side to side in valley-shaped arcs, each hand moving simultaneously with the other hand toward each side.

ACTION.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing down. Swing both hands repeatedly from side to side in valley-shaped arcs, each hand moving simultaneously with the other hand toward each side.

ACTIVE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing down. Swing both hands repeatedly from side to side in valley-shaped arcs, each hand moving simultaneously with the other hand toward each side.

RAIN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside from the forehead, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside from the forehead, main palm facing down. Move both hands down to:. Other hand: "claw 5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside of the chin, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside of the chin, main palm facing down. Hold briefly. Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the chest, main palm facing down. Hold briefly.

ALBANY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "A" shape in front of the middle of the chest, palm facing out. Move the main hand to the main side and then diagonally downward to the other side in one smooth motion. Main hand: "A" shape in front of the center of the abdomen (above the waist), palm facing out.

MYSELF.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger on the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Touch the back of the thumb twice against the chest. Hold briefly.

SELF-ONLY.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger on the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Touch the back of the thumb twice against the chest. Hold briefly.

SELF-ONLY-PL-1.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger on the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Touch the back of the thumb twice against the chest. Hold briefly.

SELF-ONLY-PL.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger on the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Touch the back of the thumb twice against the chest. Hold briefly.

YOURSELF.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger in front of the chest. Move the hand in a small front-and back motion, ending with a forward thrust. Hold briefly.

SELF-ONLY-1.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger in front of the chest. Move the hand in a small front-and back motion, ending with a forward thrust. Hold briefly.

OURSELVES.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in a shape similar to the "A" handshape (i.e. with the fingers together and curled into a fist, the thumb unopposed and closed) but with the tip of the thumb extended about an inch past the edge of the index finger on the main side of the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Put the main hand in the same shape on the other side of the chest, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing back. Hold briefly.

THIRTEEN.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "open U" (Hu) handshape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Repeatedly flatten and extend the index and middle fingers, keeping them together. Main hand: "open A" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

BEAUTIFUL.t: One-handed, usually with a pleasant smile, often with eyes closed by the end of the sign: Main hand: "5" shape near the main cheek, main palm facing you. Move the hand in a circle around the entire face (up the main side, across, down, and back to the main side), ending with a closing of the fingers into the following posture. Main hand: "open A" shape near the main jaw, main palm facing you. Hold the final posture briefly. The sign may be produced quickly to mention beauty in passing or it may be produced slowly for emphasis. Optionally shake the hand in the final posture for emphasis.

UGLY.t: One-handed, usually with a pleasant smile, often with eyes closed by the end of the sign: Main hand: "5" shape near the main cheek, main palm facing you. Move the hand in a circle around the entire face (up the main side, across, down, and back to the main side), ending with a closing of the fingers into the following posture. Main hand: "open A" shape near the main jaw, main palm facing you. Hold the final posture briefly. The sign may be produced quickly to mention beauty in passing or it may be produced slowly for emphasis. Optionally shake the hand in the final posture for emphasis.

BEAUTY.t: One-handed, usually with a pleasant smile, often with eyes closed by the end of the sign: Main hand: "5" shape near the main cheek, main palm facing you. Move the hand in a circle around the entire face (up the main side, across, down, and back to the main side), ending with a closing of the fingers into the following posture. Main hand: "open A" shape near the main jaw, main palm facing you. Hold the final posture briefly. The sign may be produced quickly to mention beauty in passing or it may be produced slowly for emphasis. Optionally shake the hand in the final posture for emphasis.

VOMIT.t: Two-handed, with head movement and facial expression imitating the act of vomiting: Other hand: "5" shape within a several inches of the tip of the finger on the main hand farthest from the thumb. Main hand: "5" shape at the mouth. Move the hands forward and down to:. Other hand: "5" shape within a several inches of the tip of the finger on the main hand farthest from the thumb. Main hand: "5" shape within several inches from the mouth.

DYE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "9" shape in front of and beside the neck, other palm facing down. Main hand: "9" shape in front of and beside the neck, main palm facing down. Move the hands down to:, then back up and back down again. Other hand: "9" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "9" shape in front of and beside the chest, main palm facing down.

CHARMED.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "5" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "5" shape with the main hand at the thumb of the other hand, main palm facing down. Wiggle the fingers of both hands while moving them toward the main side. Other hand: "5" shape in front of and to the main side of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "5" shape with the main hand at the thumb of the other hand, main palm facing down.

DONT-WANT.t: Two-handed, typically with the head shaking "no": Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up. Twist the hands inward then down while opening the fingers in a gesture that suggests throwing something away. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down.

LIKE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape within a few inches from the chest, main palm facing you. Move the hand away from the chest while drawing the thumb and middle finger closed. Main hand: "8" shape several inches from the chest, main palm facing you.

COOL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "5" shape on the chest. Wiggle the fingers of the main hand.

WHAT.t: Two-handed, with a questioning face, usually with furrowed brows: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing up. Move the hands from side to side repeatedly. Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the body, main palm facing up.

ANGRY.t: One-handed, with an angry scowl: Main hand: "claw 5" shape within a few inches from the nose, main palm facing you. Clench the fingers into a tight claw and hold briefly.

PRACTICE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "A" shape main hand on the thumb side of the finger of the other hand, palm facing across. Move the main hand repeatedly from base to tip of the other index finger.

COLOR.t: One-handed: Main hand: "5" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Wiggle the fingers of the main hand.

WHITE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "5" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Draw the hand forward from the chest while closing it. Main hand: "Flat O" shape within a few inches from the chest, main palm facing you.

DONT-LIKE.t: One-handed, with a "no" headshake or an expression of distaste: Main hand: "open 8" shape within a few inches from the chest, main palm facing you. Draw the hand forward from the chest while closing the thumb and middle finger. Main hand: "8" shape several inches from the chest, main palm facing you. Twist the hand downward while releasing the middle finger. Main hand: "claw 5" shape several inches from the chest, main palm facing down.

SORRY.t: One-handed, with a concerned expression: Main hand: "A" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Make a large vertical circle on your chest with your palm facing backward.

SORROW.t: One-handed, with a concerned expression: Main hand: "A" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Make a large vertical circle on your chest with your palm facing backward.

APOLOGIZE.t: One-handed, with a concerned expression: Main hand: "A" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Make a large vertical circle on your chest with your palm facing backward.

ATTEMPT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "A" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the chest, palm facing across. Main hand: "A" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the chest, palm facing across. Pronate the hands while moving them forward to the next posture. Other hand: "A" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "A" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down.

WATER.t: One-handed: Main hand: "6" shape at the chin, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up. After touching the chin, hold the hand still briefly.

FIVE.t: Main hand: "5" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up.

FIMM.t: Main hand: "5" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up.

FOX.t: One-handed: Main hand: "9" shape at the nose, palm facing out. Twist twice, pivoting around the nose.

MACAU.t: Main hand: "5" shape at the chin, fingers of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Twist the hand twice, pivoting on the index finger.

PLEASE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Move the main hand around the chest, at least one full circle. When used as a noun, the hand is held briefly before and after the circling movement.

PLEASURE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Move the main hand around the chest, at least one full circle. When used as a noun, the hand is held briefly before and after the circling movement.

HELLO.t: One-handed, with a smile: Main hand: "B" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, palm facing out. Hold briefly. Then move to: Move head slightly forward. Main hand: "B" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside from the forehead, palm facing out. Hold briefly.

HOW.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "bent B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "bent B" shape with the main hand at the back of the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing you. Move both hands to: by rotating the finger tips upward and the thumbs away from each other. Put the other hand in a relaxed version of the "bent B" handshape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Put the main hand in a relaxed version of the "bent B" handshape with the main hand at the ulnar edge (little-finger side) of the other hand, main palm facing up. Hold briefly.

BUSY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape at the thumb side of the other wrist, palm facing out. Hold the position of both hands briefly. Move the main hand side-to-side while holding the position of the other hand. Hold the position of both hands briefly. Note: The number of iterations and speed are variable and may be used for emphasis.

BUSINESS.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape at the thumb side of the other wrist, palm facing out. Hold the position of both hands briefly. Move the main hand side-to-side while holding the position of the other hand. Hold the position of both hands briefly. Note: The number of iterations and speed are variable and may be used for emphasis.

ENJOY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape on the body, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open B" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Move the main hand around the chest, through the following posture. Move the other hand around the body, through the following posture. Continue moving both hands at least one full circle.

IMPROVE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "B" shape at the tip (wrist end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the base (elbow end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you.

IMPROVED.t: One-handed: Main hand: "B" shape at the tip (wrist end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the base (elbow end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you.

IMPROVEMENT.t: One-handed: Main hand: "B" shape at the tip (wrist end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the other forearm, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture. Main hand: "B" shape at the base (elbow end) of the other forearm, main palm facing you.

GOOD.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "B" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Hold briefly. Hold the other hand in this posture for the duration of the sign. Move the main hand downward to contact the other palm in the next posture. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "B" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing up.

WELL.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "B" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Hold briefly. Hold the other hand in this posture for the duration of the sign. Move the main hand downward to contact the other palm in the next posture. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "B" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing up.

BEER.t: This one-handed ASL sign has one posture: Main hand: "B" shape on the main cheek. The other hand is not used. Move the main hand in circles around the cheek.

OPEN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, palm facing out. Main hand: "flat B" shape with the main hand at the thumb of the other hand, palm facing out. Swing the main hand along back to the next posture while holding the other hand still. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, palm facing out. Main hand: "flat B" shape a few inches in front of the neck, over and just ahead of the shoulder, palm facing across.

DARK.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape several inches to the other side of and in front of the nose, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape several inches to the main side of and in front of the nose, main palm facing you. Move both hands in arcs, first across the face then down, to:. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, main palm facing you.

DARKEN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape several inches to the other side of and in front of the nose, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape several inches to the main side of and in front of the nose, main palm facing you. Move both hands in arcs, first across the face then down, to:. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the neck, main palm facing you.

DRAMA.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the other side of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing toward you. Main hand: "open A" shape in front of the main side of the chest, thumb of the main hand pointing toward you. Move both hands through the following posture in alternating circles brushing the chest, then down, forward, and up with each circle.

BOX.t: This ASL sign is produced as follows: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the other side of the chest, palm facing across. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the main side of the chest, palm facing across. Drop both hands down to the next posture. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the other side of the body. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the main side of the body. Move both hands to: by bending the wrists and extending the main arm. Other hand: "flat B" shape a few inches in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape almost a full arm's length in front of the center of the chest, main palm facing you. Drop both hands down to the next posture. Other hand: "flat B" shape a few inches in front of the center of the body, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape almost a full arm's length in front of the center of the body, main palm facing you.

LIVER.t: One-handed: Main hand: "bent B" shape just below the right side of the ribcage, where the liver is located. Tap the fingers lightly against the abdomen a couple of times. Note: This is one of the few ASL signs that is always made with the right hand, regardless of which hand is main.

SANDWICH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "bent B" shape within a few inches from the mouth, other palm facing you. Main hand: "bent B" shape cupped over the back of the main hand, main palm facing you. Move both hands back toward the mouth to:. Other hand: "bent B" shape at the mouth, other palm facing you. Main hand: "bent B" shape cupped over the back of the main hand, main palm facing you.

FORGET.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape at the forehead, main palm facing you. Move the hand to: while changing the handshape. Main hand: "open A" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead, main thumb pointing toward the main side.

SCHOOL.t: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open B" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Clap the hands about two times.

SCIENCE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the other side of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing down. Main hand: "open A" shape in front of the main side of the chest, thumb of the main hand pointing down. Move both hands in repeated alternating circles across (toward the center), down, aside (toward the outside), and up. Hold briefly.

RELIEVED.t: Two-handed, with rounded, pursed lips, and usually with a puff of air during the downward movement: Other hand: "B" shape on the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands down to the next posture. Other hand: "B" shape on the abdomen, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the body, main palm facing down.

RELIEVE.t: Two-handed, with rounded, pursed lips, and usually with a puff of air during the downward movement: Other hand: "B" shape on the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands down to the next posture. Other hand: "B" shape on the abdomen, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the body, main palm facing down.

RELIEF.t: Two-handed, with rounded, pursed lips, and usually with a puff of air during the downward movement: Other hand: "B" shape on the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands down to the next posture. Other hand: "B" shape on the abdomen, other palm facing down. Main hand: "B" shape on the body, main palm facing down.

GIVE-IN.t: One-handed, with the lips initially pressed tightly together, then released as the jaw drops in the final posture: Main hand: "open B" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Hold the hand still briefly before moving it forward to: while releasing the lips and dropping the jaw. Main hand: "open B" shape several inches from the chest, main palm facing up.

LATE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape beside the body, main palm facing you. Nod the wrist repeatedly so the hand waves back.

NOT-YET.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape beside the body, main palm facing you. Nod the wrist repeatedly so the hand waves back.

TOMORROW.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open A" shape at the jaw (below the cheek and ear, behind the chin), thumb of the main hand pointing toward you. Move the hand forward while twisting the hand into the next posture. Main hand: "open A" shape a couple of inches forward from the cheek, thumb of the main hand pointing up.

OUR.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat B" shape on the main side of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. The radial (thumb) edge of the hand is in contact with the chest. Move the hand in an arc while rotating it so that it faces the opposite direction. Main hand: "flat B" shape on the other side of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. The ulnar (little finger) edge of the hand is in contact with the chest. If it is necessary to indicate which people other than the signer are the possessors, the signer may lean to the side near those people.

MY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat B" shape on the chest, main palm facing you.

YOUR.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. The palm faces the literal or figurative location of the referent (the possessor).

YOURS.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. The palm faces the literal or figurative location of the referent (the possessor) farthest to the other side of the signer. Slightly drop the hand and move it in an arc toward the main side of the body. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the chest, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. The palm faces the literal or figurative location of the referent (the possessor) farthest to the main side of the signer.

ANYTHING.t: Two-handed: Move both hands from the sides toward the center so the wrists cross each other in the following posture. Other hand: "A" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "A" shape at the other wrist, main palm facing up. Move both hands apart toward the sides while opening the fingers and thumb to:. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the shoulder, other palm facing up. Main hand: "5" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing up. Hold briefly.

DONT-KNOW.t: One-handed, optionally shaking the head "no": Main hand: "bent B" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Twist the hand away from the head in a manner that suggests throwing away. Main hand: "bent B" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead, main palm facing toward the main side.

KNOW.t: One-handed, optionally shaking the head "no": Main hand: "bent B" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Twist the hand away from the head in a manner that suggests throwing away. Main hand: "bent B" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead, main palm facing toward the main side.

INTRODUCE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "bent B" shape in front of the other side of the body, backs of the extended or bent fingers of the other hand facing down. Main hand: "bent B" shape within a several inches of the tip of the finger on the other hand, backs of the extended or bent fingers of the main hand facing down. Move the hands toward each other so the finger tips meet in the following posture. Other hand: "bent B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), backs of the extended or bent fingers of the other hand facing down. Main hand: "bent B" shape touching the tip(s) of the finger(s) of the other hand, backs of the extended or bent fingers of the main hand facing down.

WELCOME.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat B" shape several inches in front from the body (in front of and just below the chest), main palm facing up. Move the hand horizontally in to the body to the next posture. Main hand: "flat B" shape on the body, main palm facing up.

THANK-YOU.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Move the hand forward and down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape several inches from the chin, main palm facing up.

REMEMBER.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "open A" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Move the main hand down to:. Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing across the body toward the main side (contralaterally). Main hand: "open A" shape with the main hand at the back of the thumb of the other hand, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally).

TIRED.t: Two-handed, with the head dropping forward and down along with the hands: Other hand: "bent B" shape on the other side of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "bent B" shape on the main side of the chest, main palm facing you. Roll the hands down the chest to:. Other hand: "bent B" shape on the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "bent B" shape on the main side of the chest, main palm facing up.

PAGE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open A" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, thumb of the main hand pointing down. Move the main hand in a repeated circle, each moving from the palm to the other side, then up, then back to the main side, then down, contacting the other palm each time.

SLOW.t: Two-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape with the main hand at the back of the other hand, main palm facing down. Draw the main hand back at a medium or slow pace to:. Main hand: "open B" shape with the main hand at the back of the other wrist, main palm facing down. Optionally continue moving the main hand farther up the other forearm.

BAD.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Rotate the hand forward while moving it forward and aside. Main hand: "open B" shape several inches from the chin, main palm facing down.

NICE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open B" shape at the base of the other palm, main palm facing down. Wipe the main hand across the other hand from base to the fingers. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open B" shape with the main hand at the finger(s) of the other hand, main palm facing down.

BROWN.t: One-handed: Main hand: "B" shape Cheek, palm facing out. Slide the hand down the face to:. Main hand: "B" shape at the jaw (below the cheek and ear, behind the chin), palm facing out.

PUSH-ASIDE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the other side of the body, palm facing across. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of the main side of the body, main palm facing toward the main side. Move both hands somewhat to the right.

HAPPY.t: Two-handed, with a smile: Other hand: "open B" shape on the other side of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open B" shape on the main side of the chest, main palm facing you. Repeatedly brush both hands up and off the chest, returning to the chest after each brush. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the neck, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the neck, main palm facing you.

WHY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Move the hand away from the head while closing the index, middle, and ring finger. Main hand: "Y" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead. When used as a question, the sign is produced with furrowed eyebrows, squinted eyes, head tilted, and a very small headshake (i.e. pivoting slightly from side to side, not nearly so much as that of a "no" gesture). When used in a rhetorical question, the sign is produced with raised eyebrows and the head tilted slightly.

FIFTEEN.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Flatten and extend the four fingers (not including the thumb) at least twice, keeping them together. Put the main hand in a bent version of the "open B" shape, with the four fingers bent at the proximal joint but otherwise extended and together, thumb extended to make a flat hand with a gap between the thumb and the edge of the hand in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

GESTURE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the other side of the chest. Main hand: "flat B" shape in front of the main side of the chest. Move the hands in repeated, alternating circles, each going up, forward, down, then back.

EXCUSE-ME.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the chest, with the fingers pointing forward, palm up. Main hand: "bent B" shape touching the base of the other hand, main palm facing down. Brush the fingertips of the main hand across the other hand to the fingertips. Variations may do this action once, repeat it, or continue doing it until the desired effect is attained (i.e. if trying to pass by or through a signer's conversation).

EXCUSE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the chest, with the fingers pointing forward, palm up. Main hand: "bent B" shape touching the base of the other hand, main palm facing down. Brush the fingertips of the main hand across the other hand to the fingertips. Variations may do this action once, repeat it, or continue doing it until the desired effect is attained (i.e. if trying to pass by or through a signer's conversation).

ABLE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "A" shape Sternumhigh, other palm facing down. Main hand: "A" shape Sternumhigh, main palm facing down. Move the hands downward firmly a short distance. Variations may double this movement.

NIGHT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "bent B" shape with the main hand at the back of the other hand, main palm facing down. Tap the heel of the main hand about twice on the back of the other hand.

FLOOR.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "B" shape in neutral space abutting the center line of the body, with palm facing down and the tips of the fingers facing away from the signer. Main hand: "B" shape in neutral space abutting the center line of the body and hence the opposite hand, with palm facing down and the tips of the fingers facing away from the signer. Hold briefly. Move both hands smoothly away from one another until they are approximately as far as apart as the signer's shoulders. Hold briefly.

WHATS-UP.t: Two-handed, with a questioning face: Other hand: "open 8" shape on the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Move both hands in arcs from the chest up and out to the next posture. Other hand: "open 8" shape in front of and beside the neck, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape in front of and beside the neck, main palm facing you. Hold briefly.

MUCH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the center of the chest, palm facing across. Main hand: "claw 5" shape touching the tip(s) of the finger(s) of the other hand, palm facing across. Then move to: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the chest, palm facing across. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of and beside the chest, palm facing across. Alternatively, the hands may begin near each other rather than touching. Alternatively, the palm tips may point up rather than forward.

GAY.t: This one-handed ASL sign has one posture: Main hand: "G" shape with the tips of the index finger and thumb touching the chin, radial edge (the edge of the index finger and thumb) on top. Hold briefly.

BUTTER.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "H" shape at the tip of the other palm, main palm facing down. Hold the other hand in this posture for the entire duration of the sign. Draw the fingers of the main hand over the other palm toward its base. Main hand: "H" shape at the base of the other palm. Move the main hand to the starting posture and repeat at least once, typically twice. Hold the hands briefly in the final posture.

PICTURE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the other side of the chest, palm facing across. Put the main hand in the "C" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, palm facing out. Move both hands to contact each other in the following posture. Other hand: "flat B" shape in front of the center of the chest, palm facing across. Put the main hand in the "C" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, radial (thumb-side) edge of the main hand facing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Hold both hands briefly in this position.

QUEEN.t: One-handed: Place the "G" handshape between the other shoulder and the middle of the chest, thumb and index finger pointing down. The other hand is not used. Hold briefly. Move the hand down and across to:. Place the main hand in the "G" handshape on the main side of the abdomen, thumb and index finger pointing down. Hold briefly.

IRONIC.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "corna" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "corna" shape at the nose. Move both hands in opposite directions past the front of the chest, brushing the main hand over the other one as they pass each other. Other hand: "corna" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "corna" shape with the arms crossed near the wrists.

IRONY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "corna" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "corna" shape at the nose. Move both hands in opposite directions past the front of the chest, brushing the main hand over the other one as they pass each other. Other hand: "corna" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "corna" shape with the arms crossed near the wrists.

DICTIONARY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "D" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, main palm facing down. Move the main hand in repeating circles, each brushing the other palm back toward the body, then up, then forward, then down.

TEACH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "Flat O" shape within a few inches of the other side of the forehead, near the temple. Main hand: "Flat O" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple. Other hand: "Flat O" shape several inches from the other side of the forehead. Main hand: "Flat O" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead. Hold briefly.

MONEY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "Flat O" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, backs of the extended or bent fingers of the main hand facing down. Move the main hand down so the back of the fingers contact the other palm at least twice.

NAME.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "H" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "H" shape main hand on the thumb side of the finger of the other hand. Move the main hand repeatedly up and down so the pinky side of the second knuckle of the middle finger of the main hand contacts the thumb side of the second knuckle of the middle finger of the other hand. Hold briefly.

OUTSIDE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat C" shape about half an arm's length in front and aside of the mouth, palm facing across. Close the fingers to the thumb, forming the "flat O" shape, reopen them, and close them again while moving the hand aside (to the main side). Hold briefly.

KING.t: One-handed: Main hand: "K" shape with the main hand at the other shoulder, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up. Move the hand diagonally downward to:. Main hand: "K" shape with the main hand on the main side of the abdomen (the lower part of the body, just above the waist).

SEE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "K" shape with the middle finger touching the main side of the nose, index finger pointing up. Move the hand forward while rotating it so the index finger points forward. Main hand: "K" shape several inches in front of the face, finger(s) of the main hand pointing up.

THE-TWO-OF-US.t: One-handed: Main hand: "K" shape within a few inches of the chest, in between the signer's chest and that of the other referent, the index finger pointing to chest of the other referent, palm up. Rock the hand back and forth so that the middle finger points back to the signer.

THE-TWO-OF-YOU.t: One-handed: Main hand: "K" shape in front of the chest, the index finger pointing to chest of one referent, palm facing across. Rock the hand repeatedly back and forth between the previous and next posture by nodding the wrist. Main hand: "K" shape in front of the chest, middle finger pointing to the other referent, palm facing across. Hold briefly.

CUTE.t: One-handed, with a smile expressing cuteness or admiration of something cute: Main hand: "H" shape at the chin, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up. Repeatedly flatten and extend the middle and index finger. Main hand: "A" shape at the chin, main palm facing you and fingers pointing up.

BOY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "flat C" shape at the forehead. Repeatedly flatten and open the hand to alternate between the previous and next posture. Main hand: "Flat O" shape at the forehead. Hold briefly.

I-FORMAL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape on the body, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Hold briefly.

PRO-FORMAL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape on the body, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Hold briefly.

PRO-FORMAL-PL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape on the body, main palm facing up, finger(s) pointing toward you. Hold briefly.

YOU-FORMAL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape with the finger tips pointing toward the middle of the chest of the referent, main palm facing up. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape with the finger tips pointing toward the body of the referent, main palm facing up. Hold briefly.

PRO-FORMAL-1.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape with the finger tips pointing toward the middle of the chest of the referent, main palm facing up. Move the hand down to:. Main hand: "open B" shape with the finger tips pointing toward the body of the referent, main palm facing up. Hold briefly.

A.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest. Move both hands down to:. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the body. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the body. Hold briefly.

INDIVIDUAL.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest. Move both hands down to:. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the body. Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the body. Hold briefly.

MOVE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "Flat O" shape in front of and beside the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "Flat O" shape in front of the center of the chest, main palm facing down. Move both hands in parallel to:. Other hand: "Flat O" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "Flat O" shape in front of and beside the chest, main palm facing down.

DRINK.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a few inches from the mouth, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand forward. Tip the hand up as if tipping a cup to drink from it. Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a few inches from the mouth, tip (opposite end from the wrist) of the main hand facing up.

FOOD.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Flat O" shape at the mouth, main palm facing you. Optionally tap the fingers to the mouth multiple times. Hold briefly.

OK.t: One-handed: Main hand: "O" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Then move to: Main hand: "K" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out.
