EAT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "Flat O" shape within a few inches from the mouth, other palm facing you. Main hand: "Flat O" shape at the mouth, main palm facing you. Move both hands alternatingly forward and back to the mouth. Other hand: "Flat O" shape at the mouth, other palm facing you. Main hand: "Flat O" shape within a few inches from the mouth, main palm facing you.

SIT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "H" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "H" shape with the main hand at the back of the finger(s) of the other hand, fingers of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally) and palm facing down.

ORANGE.t: One-handed: Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a few inches from the chin. Squeeze the hand repeatedly. Main hand: "S" shape within a few inches from the chin.

WANT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up. Pull both hands a few inches back toward the body while slightly flexing the fingers. Other hand: "claw 5" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up.

WHO.t: One-handed: Main hand: "L" shape at the chin, thumb of the main hand pointing toward you. Repeatedly retract and extend the index finger. When used as a question, this sign is produced furrowed eyebrows, squinted eyes, head tilted, and a very small headshake (i.e. pivoting slightly from side to side, not nearly so much as that of a "no" gesture).

WRITE-DOWN.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "Flat O" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Open the main hand up and bring it down onto the other hand so the palms touch. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "open B" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down.

MONDAY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

M.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

T.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

W.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

F.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

S.t: One-handed: Main hand: "M" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

SUPPOSE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "I" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Move the hand forward to the next posture. Main hand: "I" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you.

IF.t: One-handed: Main hand: "I" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Move the hand forward to the next posture. Main hand: "I" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you.

LUCK.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Turn the hand at the wrist to face outward and slightly to the side of the face.

LUCKY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Turn the hand at the wrist to face outward and slightly to the side of the face.

GOOD-LUCK.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Turn the hand at the wrist to face outward and slightly to the side of the face.

MORNING.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "flat B" shape in the crook of the main arm, other palm facing you. Main hand: "flat B" shape with the elbow against the abdomen and the arm straight up, main palm facing up. Bring the main arm up until the palm is facing back near the shoulder with the other hand still in the crook of the elbow.

CULTURE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand, palm of the main hand facing forward and oriented so the whole hand points up. Move the main hand in an arc, first toward the main side, then forward, then back toward the other side. While doing so, rotate the main hand from palm-forward orientation to palm-back. The other hand does not move. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand, palm of the main hand facing back and oriented so the whole hand points up. Hold briefly.

CULTURAL.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand, palm of the main hand facing forward and oriented so the whole hand points up. Move the main hand in an arc, first toward the main side, then forward, then back toward the other side. While doing so, rotate the main hand from palm-forward orientation to palm-back. The other hand does not move. Other hand: "1" shape in front of the center of the chest, finger(s) of the other hand pointing up. Put the main hand in the "C" shape within a couple of inches of the finger of the other hand, palm of the main hand facing back and oriented so the whole hand points up. Hold briefly.

FEEL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. While maintaining contact with the chest, move the hand up to:. Main hand: "open 8" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing you.

FEELING.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open 8" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. While maintaining contact with the chest, move the hand up to:. Main hand: "open 8" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing you.

WAIT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the body, main palm facing up. Wiggle the fingers of both hands repeatedly.

PENDING.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the other side of the body, other palm facing up. Main hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the main side of the body, main palm facing up. Wiggle the fingers of both hands repeatedly.

EASTER.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "E" shape in front of and beside the neck, palm facing across. Main hand: "E" shape in front of and beside the neck, palm facing across. Twist the wrists so the palms face forward. Other hand: "E" shape in front of and beside the neck, palm facing out. Main hand: "E" shape in front of and beside the neck, palm facing out. Hold briefly.

INFORM.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Flat O" shape at the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Move the hand in an arc toward toward the directional object by extending the elbow. Main hand: "claw 5" shape several inches from the main side of the forehead, main palm facing up.

OBSERVE.t: This two-handed ASL sign has two postures: Form the "V" handshape with the main hand near the eyes, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Form the "V" handshape with the weak hand near the mouth, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Move both hands forward. Form the "V" handshape with the main hand a medial distance in front of the eyes, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Form the "V" handshape with the weak hand a medial distance in front of the mouth, fingers pointing forward, palm down.

OBSERVATION.t: This two-handed ASL sign has two postures: Form the "V" handshape with the main hand near the eyes, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Form the "V" handshape with the weak hand near the mouth, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Move both hands forward. Form the "V" handshape with the main hand a medial distance in front of the eyes, fingers pointing forward, palm down. Form the "V" handshape with the weak hand a medial distance in front of the mouth, fingers pointing forward, palm down.

JOG.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "S" shape in front of and beside the body, palm facing across. Main hand: "S" shape in front of and beside the chest, palm facing across. Move both hands in circles parallel with the midline (moving neither right nor left).

DOUBT.t: One-handed: Main hand: "V" shape between the eyes and tip of the nose, main palm facing you. Bend the fingers while moving the hand down and forward to:. Main hand: "Bent V" shape several inches from the chin, main palm facing you.

STRESSED-OUT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "X" shape on the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "X" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Separate the hands by moving the main hand up and the other hand down to:. Other hand: "X" shape on the abdomen, other palm facing you. Main hand: "X" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing you.

STRESS-OUT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "X" shape on the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "X" shape on the chest, main palm facing you. Separate the hands by moving the main hand up and the other hand down to:. Other hand: "X" shape on the abdomen, other palm facing you. Main hand: "X" shape on the middle of the chest, main palm facing you.

WILL.t: This one-handed ASL sign has two postures: Main hand: "open B" shape just forward of the shoulder at nose height, fingers pointing up. Move the hand forward to:. Main hand: "open B" shape about an elbow's length in front of the body, at nose height, fingers slightly forward.

SHAVE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "X" shape Cheek, palm facing out. Make a slight arc movement to:. Main hand: "X" shape at the chin, palm facing out. Repeat the movement to indicate the continuous aspect of the sign.

SATURDAY.t: One-handed: Main hand: "S" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Move the main hand in horizontal circles.

SAME-AS.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Y" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down. The pinky side of the hand or the little finger itself should be pointing toward the first object or reference location. Move the main hand side-to-side (toward the second object, then back toward the first, then back toward the second). Main hand: "Y" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down. The thumb side of the hand or the thumb itself should be pointing toward the second object or reference location. Hold briefly.

ONE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Hold briefly.

CL-1.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Hold briefly.

CUT.t: One-handed: Main hand: "V" shape in front of the area of your main shoulder and move to the other shoulder while changing repeatedly to the H shape and back, the palm facing toward the body

CRAB.t: One-handed: Main hand: "V" shape in front of the area of your main shoulder and move to the other shoulder while changing repeatedly to the H shape and back, the palm facing toward the body

FRIEND.t: Two-handed: Both hands: "X" shape with the index fingers hooked together in front of the center of the chest, main palm facing down and other palm facing up. Hold briefly. Unhook the index fingers and rotate each hand to move to:. Both hands: "X" shape with the index fingers hooked together in front of the center of the chest, main palm facing up and other palm facing down. Hold briefly.

TIME.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "claw 5" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "X" shape with the main hand at the back of the other wrist, main palm facing down. Tap the index finger of the main hand onto the other wrist repeatedly.

RESTAURANT.t: One-handed: Main hand: "R" shape on the main side of the chin, fingers pointing up. Hold the hand briefly still. Move the hand down off the chin. Main hand: "R" shape below the main side of the chin. Move the hand up and across to the next posture. Main hand: "R" shape on the other side of the chin, fingers pointing up. Move the hand down off the chin. Main hand: "R" shape below the other side of the chin. Hold the hand briefly still.

CELEBRATE.t: Two-handed: Both hands: "X" shape beside the space in front of the chin. Move both hands in horizontal circles.

SEATTLE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "S" shape a few inches in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Hold briefly. Move the hand a few inches from side to side. Hold briefly.

RECENTLY.t: One-handed, with the head turned slightly toward the other side and with the main cheek tensed: Main hand: "X" shape with the pinky side of the index finger against the cheek, palm facing you. Repeatedly flex and loosen the medial joint of the index finger.

EXACT.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "Small O" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "Small O" shape with the tip of the main thumb and index finger near the tip of the other thumb and index finger, main palm facing down. Imagine a line running through both thumb tips. The imaginary line should be perpendicular to both palms. Hold both hands still briefly Move the main hand so the tip of the thumb and finger encircles the imaginary line one or more times. Drop the main hand down along the imaginary line so the tip of the main thumb and finger contacts the tip of the other thumb and finger. Hold both hands still briefly

APPROXIMATE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "Small O" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "Small O" shape with the tip of the main thumb and index finger near the tip of the other thumb and index finger, main palm facing down. Imagine a line running through both thumb tips. The imaginary line should be perpendicular to both palms. Hold both hands still briefly Move the main hand so the tip of the thumb and finger encircles the imaginary line one or more times. Drop the main hand down along the imaginary line so the tip of the main thumb and finger contacts the tip of the other thumb and finger. Hold both hands still briefly

RIDE-IN.t: Two-handed: Put the other hand in the "C" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "Bent V" shape with the main index finger and middle finger wrapped over the other thumb, main palm facing down. Move both hands forward.

RIDE.t: Two-handed: Put the other hand in the "C" shape in front of the center of the chest. Main hand: "Bent V" shape with the main index finger and middle finger wrapped over the other thumb, main palm facing down. Move both hands forward.

UNDERSTAND.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Small O" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Release the index finger from the thumb, extending it fully to:. Main hand: "1" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Optionally close the index finger back to the thumb and release it again.

DONT-UNDERSTAND.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Small O" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Release the index finger from the thumb, extending it fully to:. Main hand: "1" shape within a few inches of the main side of the forehead, near the temple, main palm facing you. Optionally close the index finger back to the thumb and release it again.

OLD.t: One-handed: Main hand: "S" shape at the chin. Main hand: "S" shape several inches from the chin.

AGE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "S" shape at the chin. Main hand: "S" shape several inches from the chin.

REVIEW.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, palm facing across. Put the main hand in the "open R" (Ru) handshape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally). Rotate the main hand forward and down, pivoting on the main thumb. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, palm facing across. Put the main hand in the "open R" (Ru) handshape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally) and fingers pointing down.

WRONG.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Y" shape at the chin, main palm facing you. Hold briefly.

STAND.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "V" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down. Hold briefly.

JUMP.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "V" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down. Bend the index and middle finger of the main hand while moving it a few inches up to:. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "Bent V" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down.

DANCE.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the body (typically with the upper arm hanging straight down from the shoulder, the elbow bent at a right angle, and the forearm pointing diagonally ahead from the elbow), other palm facing up. Main hand: "V" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, finger(s) of the main hand pointing down. Move the finger tips of the main hand from side to side by rotating the forearm repeatedly.

YES.t: One-handed, often with the head nodding "yes": Main hand: "S" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Nod the hand at least once. Main hand: "S" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing down.

MANY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "S" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "S" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up. Release the fingers and extend the thumb while moving the hand slightly up and/or forward. Other hand: "5" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "5" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing up. ( how many? ): When used as a question, it is produced with furrowed eyebrows, squinted eyes, head tilted, and a very small headshake (i.e. pivoting slightly from side to side, not nearly so much as that of a "no" gesture).

THERE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing down. Hold briefly. The sign may also be produced with different palm orientations, but if the radial (thumb-side) edge of the hand faces up, this sign becomes a homophone for 1@InsideChesthigh-RadialUp ( " you, he, she, it " ) API.

YELLOW.t: One-handed: Main hand: "Y" shape in front of the shoulder. Repeatedly twist the hand clockwise and counterclockwise. Main hand: "Y" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

FIRST.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Supinate the hand by twisting it so the palm faces back. Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

LAST.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Supinate the hand by twisting it so the palm faces back. Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

ONE-DOLLAR.t: One-handed: Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Supinate the hand by twisting it so the palm faces back. Main hand: "1" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you.

DRUG.t: One-handed: Main hand: "S" shape within a couple of inches from the base (elbow end) of the other forearm, main palm facing up. Move the hand back and forth, toward and away from the base of the forearm. Main hand: "S" shape at the base (elbow end) of the other forearm, main palm facing up. When used as a verb, there is just one movement toward the arm instead of a repeated movement back and forth.

STUCK.t: One-handed: Main hand: "V" shape within a few inches from the top of the neck, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you. Drop finger tips down to:. Main hand: "V" shape at the bottom of the neck, finger(s) of the main hand pointing toward you.

GOODBYE.t: One-handed: Main hand: "open B" shape in front of and beside the chest, palm facing out. Flap the four fingers up and down as a group to form the "Bent B" handshape repeatedly.

EACH.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture while twisting the hand so the base faces to the side and the thumb points across the body toward the base of the other hand. Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape several inches of the ulnar (little-finger) side of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally).

EVERY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture while twisting the hand so the base faces to the side and the thumb points across the body toward the base of the other hand. Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape several inches of the ulnar (little-finger) side of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally).

ANY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture while twisting the hand so the base faces to the side and the thumb points across the body toward the base of the other hand. Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape several inches of the ulnar (little-finger) side of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally).

MOST.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape within a couple of inches of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing up. Move the main hand in an arc to the next posture while twisting the hand so the base faces to the side and the thumb points across the body toward the base of the other hand. Other hand: "open A" shape in front of the center of the chest, thumb of the other hand pointing up. Main hand: "open A" shape several inches of the ulnar (little-finger) side of the other palm, thumb of the main hand pointing across the body toward the other side (contralaterally).

TECHNOLOGY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand in a couple of inches of the ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the other hand, palm facing across. Tap the middle finger of the main hand once or more on the ulnar edge of the other hand. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the other hand, palm facing across. Hold briefly.

TECHNICAL.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand in a couple of inches of the ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the other hand, palm facing across. Tap the middle finger of the main hand once or more on the ulnar edge of the other hand. Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing you. Main hand: "open 8" shape with the main hand at the ulnar (little-finger-side) edge of the other hand, palm facing across. Hold briefly.

NEW-YORK.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "open B" shape in front of the center of the chest, other palm facing up. Main hand: "Y" shape with the main hand at the palm of the other hand, main palm facing down. Move the main hand from side to side across the other hand while holding the other hand still.

TRY.t: Two-handed: Other hand: "T" shape a few inches in front of the other side of the chest, palm facing across. Main hand: "T" shape a few inches in front of the main side of the chest, palm facing across. Pronate the hands while moving them forward to the next posture. Other hand: "T" shape in front of the other side of the chest, other palm facing down. Main hand: "T" shape in front of the main side of the chest, main palm facing down.

FATHER.t: This one-handed ASL sign has one repeated posture: Main hand: "5" shape with the thumb touching the forehead. Repeatedly touch the thumb to the forehead.

ASL.t: One-handed: Main hand: "A" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Main hand: "S" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Main hand: "L" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out.

I-LOVE-YOU.t: One-handed, with an affectionate smile: Main hand: "I/L/Y" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing out. Hold briefly. The hand may be moved or rotated to indicate the subject and object of the affection. The back of the hand faces toward the subject. The palm faces toward the object.

0.t: Main hand: "O" shape in front of the shoulder, palm facing across.

FOUR.t: One-handed: Main hand: "4" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Hold briefly.

FJ.t: One-handed: Main hand: "4" shape in front of the shoulder, main palm facing you. Hold briefly.
